Description: feed_id is the uint32 Pyth Lazer feed identifier.
timestamp is the price timestamp extracted from the verified payload (microseconds from epoch).
price_state holds the verified price, cumulative price, and block timestamp.
ema_price is the upstream emaPrice value from the verified Pyth Lazer payload, scaled with the feed exponent.

ema_timestamp is the feed update timestamp associated with ema_price (microseconds from epoch). It advances only when a verified payload contains both emaPrice and a valid per-feed feedUpdateTimestamp.
